scripts.lint: vp check && taplo fmt --check && bun scripts/check-version.ts && bun scripts/check-layers.ts && bun scripts/parity/check.ts
scripts.test:e2e: SIWX_E2E_ANVIL=1 bun --cwd packages/siwx test tests/e2e/ && SIWX_E2E_ANVIL=1 cargo test -p siwx --test e2e_anvil --features rpc
scripts.test:parity: bun scripts/parity/differential.ts --seed 42 && SIWX_DIFFERENTIAL=../../target/parity/differential.json cargo test -p siwx --test differential --all-features -- --ignored
scripts.test:parity:random: seed=$((RANDOM * RANDOM)); echo "seed: $seed"; bun scripts/parity/differential.ts --seed $seed --count 5000 && SIWX_DIFFERENTIAL=../../target/parity/differential.json cargo test -p siwx --test differential --all-features -- --ignored
